_about: E. H. Knatchbull-Hugessen's fairy stories for children: River Legends, or Father Thames and Father Rhine (1875) and Uncle Joe's Stories (London, 1879). In River Legends the closing frame story and the Rhine King's six-stanza song follow the last stanza of Sir Roderick Fowle with no heading of their own, so they are cited under it and the song's stanza numbers take ~2. Gutenberg catalogue: Knatchbull-Hugessen (Baron Brabourne) 1829-1893. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-10: Adam asked the project to keep going until he stops it; Adam may veto).
